claim: On five cryptocurrencies the alarms carry information beyond EWMA and HAR volatility forecasts
evidence: Q6e is in the docstring of e06b_five_coins_monitor.py, first committed together with its results (d0caeb1); the monitor settings were frozen in E5 (bf67e2b), which precedes E6 (verifiable). No test is named primary. The HAR forecast's training history was changed after the first full run (docs/iterations/E6.md, iteration 5), so the HAR rows are post hoc in their forecast definition.
adjusted_status: partly holds: hit rates against EWMA and HAR forecasts hold (F2); against the strongest forecast (HAR with the last hour) only decrease alarms add information (F17: e-detector down Holm p = 0.046, up 0.32); scaling that forecast at alarms did not lower held-out QLIKE (F18)

claim: On the Nifty 50 index and around FOMC statements the alarms follow scheduled events far more often than control times
evidence: Budget: one of five event types in the docstring of e07d_events.py, committed with the results (c20ea73); no primary event type. FOMC on BTC: member of the primary family stated in the docstring of e12_crypto_events.py, committed with the results (47a5982).
adjusted_status: holds for Union Budget sessions (F10a, F10b) and FOMC on BTC (F12a); does not hold for CPI on BTC, the other member of the primary family (F12a, p = 0.11)

claim: A ratio rule tuned with hindsight is about as precise
evidence: The rate-matched ratio rule is in the E6b docstring (d0caeb1, with results); windows 60 and 240 minutes 'fixed before running' (docs/iterations/E6.md, iteration 6). The claim is an equivalence claim; no margin was set in advance.
adjusted_status: no difference significant after Holm at band 0.25; equivalence within 5 points shown in 7 of 8 held-out cells and in none of the 8 Jul to Dec 2025 cells

claim: Published change-point methods given day-long windows come close
evidence: The longer windows were added in review round 3 (fca74a5) after the first real results (53f9eba); docstring: 'Added after the first runs (review round 3)'.
adjusted_status: exploratory; down alarms: no significant difference, equivalence not shown; up alarms: e-detector higher after Holm in 5 of 8 day-long cells

claim: Restarted monitors were confirmed by the next day's volatility about as often (five coins, band 0.25)
evidence: Q14d is in the E14 docstring at d9871f4 (2 Nov 21:20), before the results (e955821, 21:52). An equivalence claim with no margin set in advance.
adjusted_status: does not hold for the rank version's increase alarms (6.7 points fewer, Holm p = 0.006); band version: no significant difference, equivalence not shown

claim: Restarted monitors: the BTC CPI cell gave p = 0.003 and 0.0003 instead of 0.11
evidence: Q14g was described before its own run (d9871f4, 21:20) but designed after E12's results, in which the BTC CPI test failed, were committed (47a5982, 21:01); it is outside E12's pre-registered primary family and cannot rescue it.
adjusted_status: exploratory; Holm p = 0.011 and 0.0027 within F13; cannot replace E12's primary CPI test

claim: At matched alarm counts the 5- and 15-minute detectors alone were no more precise than the one-minute monitor
evidence: part_ratematch is marked 'POST HOC (review round 4, M5)' (ef65698), after the real results (5da9ac2).
adjusted_status: exploratory; no cell favours the coarse detector, 2 of 12 favour the one-minute monitor after Holm; equivalence shown in 1 of 12 cells
